title: Turing Test and the Practice of Law: The Role of Autonomous Levels of AI Legal Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a proposed variant of the Turing Test specifically for AI Legal Reasoning (AILR) and its levels of autonomy. While it mentions 'Artificial Moral Agency' in its bibliography, the core content of the paper defines legal reasoning capabilities and benchmarking autonomous performance in the legal domain rather than evaluating religious, moral, or ethical systems.
